themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: EasyJet's take-private is still a two-bidder contest between Castlelake (ezj-castlelake-takeover) and Apollo (ezj-apollo-takeover), ITV sold its broadcast arm to Comcast's Sky (itv-sky-me-sale), and Prologis's 'best and final' bid for Segro has now flipped the board to 'minded to recommend' as the PUSU deadline is extended to Aug 12 (pld-sgro-takeover-bid) — UK-listed names remain a magnet for control-changing bids.

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: PE- and shareholder-led buyouts keep pulling listed names private: EasyJet's take-private is a live Castlelake vs Apollo bidding war (ezj-castlelake-takeover, ezj-apollo-takeover), Steel Partners is bidding $16.75/share for InMode (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), EQT/Advent/KKR are circling Qiagen (qgen-pe-consortium-takeover-interest), Vista Equity Partners and Quinti Capital have approached Criteo (crto-vista-quinti-takeover-interest), Perfect Corp.'s founder took the company private (perf-projectny-going-private), EQT keeps sweetening its Perpetual bid — now A$22.07/share (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid), Frasers Group's shareholder-led tender for Hugo Boss has crossed the mandatory-offer threshold with acceptance running to July 27 (boss-frasers-takeover-offer), and Stripe and Advent's joint $53bn+ offer for PayPal, rejected by the board but still live (pypl-stripe-advent-takeover-bid).

themes.label: Defense primes racing for undersea/anti-submarine-warfare tech
themes.note: Defense primes keep building out undersea-warfare capability: Thales's control deal for mine-clearing drone maker Exail (ho-exail-acquisition), Lockheed's $3.45bn purchase of sonar specialist Ultra Maritime (lmt-ultra-maritime-acquisition), and Fincantieri bundling four acquisitions into an underwater-tech champion (fct-underwater-champion-acquisitions).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital and commercial partnerships keep pouring into the physical layer of AI compute: TeraWulf's 20-year, ~$19bn AI data-center lease with Anthropic (wulf-anthropic-lease), Meta's expansion of its Louisiana campus to 5GW and $50bn+ (meta-richland-parish-capex), Williams's $5.34bn Blackstone-led JV to fund five behind-the-meter data-center power projects (wmb-blackstone-power-jv), 3M and Microsoft's partnership to deploy 3M's optical technology across Azure's AI data centers (mmm-msft-ai-datacenter-partnership), Microsoft's commitment to deploy AMD's Helios AI systems at scale on Azure (msft-amd-helios-partnership), and now AMD's own up-to-$5bn equity bet on Anthropic tied to a 2GW MI450 chip deployment (amd-anthropic-chip-partnership).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep drawing legal fire: the already-signed, DOJ-cleared Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger remains paused by a federal judge's TRO after suits from a 12-state AG coalition and the Writers Guild of America, with a preliminary-injunction hearing set for Aug 3 (psky-wbd-acquisition), while InMode's Special Committee remains procedurally frozen pending the Israeli court's ruling on competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).
